Test.Text: CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vTimeSeries] AS SELECT [ModelRegion] ,[TimeIndex] ,Sum([Quantity]) AS [Quantity] ,Sum([Amount]) AS [Amount] ,[CalendarYear] ,[Month] ,[ReportingDate] FROM [dbo].[vDMPrep] CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CASE [Model] WHEN 'Mountain-100' THEN 'M200' WHEN 'Road-150' THEN 'R250' WHEN 'Road-650' THEN 'R750' WHEN 'Touring-1000' THEN 'T1000' ELSE Left([Model], 1) + Right([Model], 3) END + ' ' + [Region] AS [ModelRegion] , (Convert(Integer, [CalendarYear]) * 100) + Convert(Integer, [Month]) AS [TimeIndex] , [dbo].[udfBuildISO8601Date] ([CalendarYear], [Month], 25) AS ReportingDate ) _ WHERE [Model] IN ('Mountain-100', 'Mountain-200', 'Road-150', 'Road-250', 'Road-650', 'Road-750', 'Touring-1000') GROUP BY [ModelRegion] ,[TimeIndex] ,[CalendarYear] ,[Month] ,[ReportingDate]
